comparison.objective: Remove a transverse restraint bar and open a drawer; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize obstruction, slide a long bar from sleeves and pull a drawer versus recessed hex-key use, collar rotation, torque control and cyclic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires bar removal and ≥18 cm drawer opening without damage; candidate requires locked setting retention and two bounded-energy stops without bottoming or rebound.
comparison.reason: The drawer task tests restraint removal and prismatic opening, not adjustment of dynamic dissipation.
